zh-CN.title: 头像框从数量转向设计质量
items: 下架八款辨识度不足或过度依赖换色与条纹的头像框，候选库重新归为五个清晰系列
时隙、彗星与星轨改为装饰元素沿圆角边缘运动，不再旋转整个头像框
历史选择会自动迁移到最接近的保留款式，不会突然丢失头像装饰

en.title: Avatar frames now favor design quality over quantity
items: Eight low-identity frames built mainly from color or stripe changes have been retired, leaving five focused collections
Portal, Comet, and Orbit now move ornaments along the rounded perimeter instead of rotating the entire frame
Existing selections migrate to the closest retained design so avatar decoration is never lost unexpectedly
